Both named skills exist as bundled skills: `assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` and `assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md`. The `## Gotchas` section comes after the workflow and is not part of it. It also mentions habeas-evidence, which is consistent with the workflow's ending.

No violation matches were listed, and I found no gap.
